competences.description: Attacks the enemy with a strong mental force and removes all beneficial effects.

Manifests a horrible delusion and attacks all enemies and decreases the Defense for 3 turns. Absorbs the enemy's Attack Bar by 100% if the Boss attacks the enemy with no beneficial effects. Damage increases according to the number of merges.
Summons 2 of the 3 incarnations within and removes all harmful effects. Each incarnation will have its own skill and characteristics, and will merge with Lyrith after 5 turns.
